coverage.title: Duplicates and content identity
coverage.remaining_gap: Relocation duplication is documented; content hashes, duplicate reconciliation and changed-file identity rules are not.

coverage.title: Large library virtualization
coverage.remaining_gap: Large-library import status is documented; virtualization internals, maximum track counts and search/scroll performance guarantees are not.

coverage.title: Musical key analysis
coverage.remaining_gap: Key calculation/overwrite/lock rules are documented; detector algorithm, accuracy, confidence and tuning behavior remain hidden.

coverage.title: Internal/external mixing modes
coverage.remaining_gap: Conditional software/hardware mixer ownership is documented; exact per-model channel maps and internal/external routing need hardware guides and measurement.

coverage.title: Recording limits and recovery
coverage.remaining_gap: Space display, unsaved temp file and 2 GB rollover are documented; disk-full, permission-loss, crash finalization and damaged-file recovery are not established.

coverage.title: Hot plug and route recovery
coverage.remaining_gap: Connection failures are documented; uninterrupted hot-plug recovery, safe rerouting and transient/burst behavior are not.

coverage.title: Clock drift and multiple devices
coverage.remaining_gap: No official source found for general independent-device audio-clock synchronization, drift correction or aggregate-device guarantees. DVS Anti-Drift concerns control-tone flutter and is not evidence of this feature.

coverage.title: Long-session resource stability
coverage.remaining_gap: CPU/dropout indicators are documented; long-session memory, callback scheduling and soak guarantees are engineering acceptance goals, not established reference contracts.

coverage.title: Device inventory and capabilities
coverage.remaining_gap: Startup/MIDI detection and hardware-dependent ranges are documented; universal capability enumeration and unsupported-device reporting are not.

coverage.title: MIDI timing and control semantics
coverage.remaining_gap: MIDI interpretation modes are documented; numerical byte semantics, clock/timestamp accuracy, 14-bit resolution, soft takeover and jitter require additional sources or captures.

coverage.title: CDJ/media-player integration
coverage.remaining_gap: HID setup and one firmware boundary are documented; each supported player/firmware/control/feedback combination still requires its guide and physical test.

coverage.title: USB storage behavior
coverage.remaining_gap: Portable-library attach/absence/eject behavior is documented; surprise removal during playback, write interruption and filesystem corruption recovery remain unknown.

coverage.title: Reference shell and layouts
coverage.remaining_gap: Named display/control outcomes are documented; exact dimensions, pixel matching, responsive layout and transitions still require installed-version observation.

coverage.title: Preferences and reset
coverage.remaining_gap: Concrete preferences and conditional tabs are documented; global preference reset, undo scope and every preference persistence edge case remain unknown.

coverage.title: Accessibility and reduced motion
coverage.remaining_gap: Text resizing is documented; screen-reader semantics, complete focus behavior, contrast and reduced-motion support are not established as reference behavior.

coverage.title: Offline account-free operation
coverage.remaining_gap: Reference activation conditions are documented. Unrestricted account-free local behavior is an explicit Open Play product requirement and deliberate departure, not a Serato parity fact.

coverage.title: Session persistence and recovery
coverage.remaining_gap: Manual backup/migration is documented; transactional crash recovery and restored transport/session state are not.

coverage.title: Optional provider integrations
coverage.remaining_gap: Selected provider authorization/offline/failure restrictions are documented; all provider/account/region combinations, credentials, APIs and local-playback isolation are not tested.

coverage.title: Installer, permissions and updates
coverage.remaining_gap: Installer and update-check entry points are documented; current full OS matrix, permission-denial paths, automatic updates, rollback and data-preserving failures remain open.

coverage.title: Open-source build and provenance
coverage.remaining_gap: Open-source reproducibility/provenance is an Open Play engineering requirement. The Serato manual introduction does not support such a feature. No fabricated reference row added.

coverage.title: Mappings/extensions compatibility
coverage.remaining_gap: MIDI preset management is documented; arbitrary extension compatibility, invalid-preset rejection, parser recovery and isolation remain unverified.

coverage.title: Loop roll and underlying timeline
coverage.remaining_gap: Momentary roll and underlying timeline are documented; right-deck/four-deck shortcut text has a contradiction and simultaneous input edge cases remain unverified.

coverage.title: Hercules Inpulse 300 MK2 full default mapping
coverage.remaining_gap: Core controls and eight-mode entry paths are now explicit. Fine-grained pad-slot semantics, remaining modifiers, MIDI encodings, LED packets, reconnect and four-output physical verification still require further detailed rows/tests.

coverage.title: Version comparison and historical removed/gated features
coverage.remaining_gap: Specific FX and provider transitions are documented; no verified personal entitlement-loss history or complete 4.0.9-to-4.0.10 behavior diff exists.
